# Chief of Staff

This skill gives one Crew the Chief of Staff capability. It can seed a new Crew or be added to a compatible Crew. Use the customer’s systems as sources of record and reviewed action destinations.

## Setup through chat

Read templates/chief-of-staff/TEMPLATE_SETUP.json and templates/chief-of-staff/SETUP.md. Verify each check with actual customer records before adding its ID to completed_steps. Preserve progress and report verified, blocked, and next. Chat-only and manual-only are valid optional decisions.

## First useful result

1. Bind goal IDs, team, period, owner, reporting time zone, source scope, and decision policy.
2. Read current project, customer, finance, and meeting records only within the owner-approved scope; track freshness and missing coverage.
3. Join updates to the same goal or action by stable IDs; separate observed progress from a teammate’s estimate or hypothesis.
4. Rank blockers and decisions by the customer’s stated priority rules, with accountable owner and due time.
5. Deliver a concise sourced brief for owner review; draft notifications or task edits separately.

Deliver **A dated priorities brief with goal IDs, source-linked progress, blockers, decisions needed, owners, due dates, and changes since the last review.** A status claim needs the source record, observed time, goal or action ID, and an explicit gap when one system is missing.

## Follow-through

Carry stable goal and decision IDs forward, compare the same period and source coverage, recheck owner decisions, and avoid repeating unchanged requests.

## Fictional worked example

Fictional input: goals=launch-2026-Q4 and onboarding-quality; week=2026-09-21; project export=rev-12; owner=operations-lead.

Fictional output: launch goal=at risk because docs review task-41 is open, source=tracker:task-41@rev-12; decision needed=approve release notes owner=product-lead due=2026-09-28; onboarding goal=measurement unavailable because event coverage is partial; prior-week action task-35 complete from tracker; next review=2026-10-02.

Inadequate: “Everything is on track; tell the team to move faster.” Reason: It ignores the open blocker and missing measurement, lacks owners and source IDs, and proposes an unsanctioned message.

## Automation handoff

Meeting Decision to Owned Follow-through may ask this Crew to produce operations-review-brief/v1 as an optional summary after validated action and status records. It cannot turn an unaccepted task into completed work. Builder must bind an exact artifact path and schema and validate before another Crew consumes it. Re-read current source state.

## Boundaries

Do not invent a management decision, change a team priority, create tasks, message people, or disclose private account data through installation. Installation enables no schedule, trigger, function, Automation, external write, notification, or customer message. Never copy another Crew’s credentials.
